name: beyond_onehealth
title: Simulation, inference and decisions
description: Public tools cover field/equation/reaction specification with OP System, PDE/nonlocal/reaction simulation with OP Engine, campaigns with FlepiMoP2, and replicated evaluation with trade-study. op_infer adds parameter inference, calibration and study-design checks; it is private, pre-alpha and unreleased.

name: obs_model_general
title: Partial observability across scientific domains
description: A latent process x(t) produces data y through an observation model p(y given x and observation parameters). Health, marine, earth and human systems have different observation assumptions and validation requirements.

name: future_directions_general
title: Generalize, harden, operationalize
description: The research agenda connects scientific systems, ongoing work on parameter inference, calibration, structural evaluation and rank selection, and decisions about interventions and surveillance. Observations and diagnostics inform new study choices.

name: op_system_slide
title: OP System compilation and numerical contracts
description: PDEs, nonlocal field dynamics, compartmental models and reactions are specified with coordinates and parameters, compiled through restricted syntax and typed IR, and published as shaped evaluators plus operator, reaction, observable and forcing contracts. Numerical consumers own discretization and time/event integration; cross-axis constraints remain metadata.

name: op_engine_slide
title: OP Engine numerical workflow
description: Prepare fields, states, rates and transport/mixing/reaction operators; solve discretized PDE and nonlocal models or stochastic reactions; record observations and counts; check accuracy and replay. Independent SSA clocks use NumPy. Backend qualification and replay derivatives are method-specific.

name: op_infer_slide
title: op_infer research capabilities
description: op_infer capabilities include fitting through established libraries, calibration checks on simulated data, and replicated study comparisons. Private, pre-alpha and unreleased.

name: flepimop2_slide
title: FlepiMoP2 campaign orchestration
description: Validated configuration selects System, Engine, parameter, persistence, process and job providers. Campaign execution produces persisted results and metadata through replaceable providers.

name: trade_study_slide
title: Replicated design and evaluation with trade-study
description: Declare factors, objectives and constraints; run replicated or paired simulations; compare Pareto fronts and preferences; retain provenance-checked results. Calibration and transfer require separate application evidence.

name: pp_eigentest_schematic
title: Signal rank with incomplete data
description: Ongoing signal-rank research connects incomplete data, Bayesian latent-variable modeling, and assessment of signal and uncertainty. The methods and software remain in development.

name: vbpca_py_schematic
title: VBPCApy missing-data workflow
description: Observed entries and a mask feed variational fitting of loadings, scores, bias, noise and ARD. Convergence, component selection and held-out assessment support posterior prediction and uncertainty for the intended data regime.

name: optimal_design
title: Illustrative observation-design tradeoffs
description: Synthetic candidate costs and utilities illustrate Pareto efficiency and selection under a declared budget. These values are illustrative inputs, not a fitted study or empirical information estimates.

name: structural_fidelity_comparison
title: Predictive evaluation and structural admissibility
description: Constructed trajectories illustrate adherence to a declared prevalence bound. No predictive scores are computed; predictive scoring and structural checks answer separate evaluation questions.
